name: autofix-board
description: Ticket-board autofix loop. Seeds ONE board ticket per finding at status todo, then loops a board-fixer (fixes todo tickets, moves each it addresses to to-be-reviewed) and a board-auditor (verifies each to-be-reviewed ticket's fix in the actual code, moving it to done or back to todo), bounded to 3 cycles, then publishes. The ticket board is the shared work list AND the coverage gate: a finding is 'done' only when the auditor confirms the fix is really in the code, and anything not done is left visible on the board as the honest needs-human set. Inputs {namespace, repo, ref, project, findings, number?}; findings is a numbered list of review findings (file:line + issue + fix).

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}"; git rev-parse HEAD > /workspace/.fixbase; echo "working on branch ${inputs.ref}:"; git log --oneline -1

with.task:
Seed the review board with these findings, one ticket each (status todo):

${inputs.findings}
Work the review board for this repository: list the 'todo' tickets, fix each one in the code, and move each fixed ticket to 'to-be-reviewed'. Address every todo ticket.

Audit the review board: list the 'to-be-reviewed' tickets and, for each, verify in the actual code that the fix is really present and correct. Move a genuinely-fixed ticket to 'done'; move an unfixed or wrong one back to 'todo'.

with.run: set +e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; echo '=== diffstat vs base ==='; BASE=$(cat /workspace/.fixbase 2>/dev/null); git diff --stat "$BASE" HEAD 2>/dev/null | tail -20; echo done

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; REF='${inputs.ref}'; git rm -q -r --ignore-unmatch .review .board AUDIT.md STRENGTH.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; git -c user.email=publish@forge.cicd -c user.name=publish commit -q -am 'chore: drop review artifacts' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no fix commits -- nothing to push'; fixed=0; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the fix to $REF"; fixed=1; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"
